# read_funct_1d (Operator)

## Name

`read_funct_1d` — Read a function from a file.

## Signature

`def read_funct_1d(file_name: str) -> Sequence[Union[float, int]]`

`def read_funct_1d_s(file_name: str) -> Union[float, int]`

## Description

The operator `read_funct_1d` reads the contents of
*`file_name`* and converts it into the function
*`function`*. The file has be generated by
[`write_funct_1d`](write_funct_1d.md).

## Execution Information

- Multithreading type: reentrant (runs in parallel with non-exclusive operators).
- Multithreading scope: global (may be called from any thread).
- Processed without parallelization.

## Parameters

**`file_name`** (input_control)  filename.read `→` str

Name of the file to be read.

**`function`** (output_control)  function_1d `→` Sequence[Union[float, int]]

Function from the file.

## Result

If the parameters are correct the operator `read_funct_1d`
returns the value 2 (
H_MSG_TRUE)
. Otherwise an exception is raised.

## Alternatives

`fread_string`,
`read_tuple`
